title: CheckerIdentity
description: Pins a checker to an exact digest and runtime environment.

protocol_version.description: Checker protocol version. Must match the engine's protocol version.

checker_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the checker binary or image.

schema_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the input/output schema used by this checker.

network.description: Network access level permitted for this checker invocation.

kind.description: The execution runtime for this checker.

digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the runtime image (for 'oci' and 'wasi').
